name: Colorado River — Pumphouse to State Bridge
blurb: Upper Colorado below Gore Canyon: BLM Pumphouse and Radium fee sites, Class II–III Little Gore and Red Gorge, to Eagle County's State Bridge.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Little Gore Canyon. BLM fee sites at both ends. Mileage: BLM Upper Colorado River Guide (Pumphouse to Dotsero), 2015.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Rancho del Rio (private operator) — Rancho del Rio
takeOutAccess.note: The operator explicitly offers river access for rafters and anglers. The BLM recreation guide identifies this private fee site and its launching area. The BLM StoryMap action a-mV1n40 centers on this facility, matching buildings, parking and river frontage in imagery. This is an approximate facility coordinate, not an agency-surveyed ramp. Owner terms and fees apply.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use Rancho del Rio at 4199 Trough Road, about four road miles east of State Bridge. Check with the operator for current launch, parking and shuttle fees and availability. Follow staff directions to the river; the Area marker is inside the facility.
